neighbours.label: Two Arabic expressions: the word ضحايا / الضحايا ('victims'), and the phrase بما في ذلك / بما فيهم ('including', peaking on في, the stronger trigger). Quiet for other Arabic words for dead or injured, for plain في ('in'), and for 'victims' in other languages.
neighbours.notes: Last-layer sparse pole with scattered tops (Korean 휴대 ~0.2, a memorised WHO name, Japanese brand pieces); the two Arabic expressions were the most repeatable. Test sentences written blind by a second author from the label only; the solver's leak texts were placed by that author.
